summary_and_theme.summary: Gopi hears a thud in his garden and discovers a stray hockey ball amongst the dry leaves. He brings it to the playground where his friends are delighted. During an energetic hockey game, Jay strikes the ball so hard that it flies over the gate and lands right in the basket of a passing scooter. Unaware, the scooterist rides away with the ball. The children burst into laughter at the unexpected turn of events.
summary_and_theme.core_theme: Childhood playfulness, friendship, sportsmanship, and finding humor in accidental mishaps.

character_sketches.name: Gopi
character_sketches.profile: An inquisitive young boy who investigates strange sounds in his garden, finds the lost hockey ball, and enthusiastically shares it with his friends.

character_sketches.name: Jay
character_sketches.profile: An energetic young hockey player whose powerful hit inadvertently sends the ball landing into a passing scooter's basket.

reading_extracts.extract: Jay tightened his wrist around the stick with the flat side touching the ball. He hit the ball so hard that it went past the playground gate and fell into the basket of a passing scooter. The scooterist who was unaware of what had happened, drove past. By the time the children ran to the gate, the scooter was gone … and so was the ball. They looked at each other and burst into laughter.

writing_prompts.topic: Imagine where the scooter went and who finally found the hockey ball.
writing_prompts.model_answer: The scooterist drove all the way to the vegetable market. When he stopped to buy fresh tomatoes, he glanced down at his scooter basket and was surprised to see a shiny white hockey ball resting inside! Just then, a young boy named Rahul was walking by with his father. The scooterist smiled and handed the ball to Rahul, who happily ran home to play hockey with his brother.

grammar_exercises.instruction: Identify or complete the sentences using adverbs of frequency/time (usually, suddenly, hard, past):

items.q: Jay hit the ball so ________ that it cleared the gate.
items.explanation: 'Hard' is an adverb describing the intensity of the hit.

items.q: ________, a sound came from the dry leaves.
The children ________ play hockey in the evening.
The scooterist drove ________ the playground gate.
items.explanation: 'Past' describes movement going by a location.

short_answer.question: How did Gopi discover the hockey ball in his garden?
short_answer.answer: Gopi heard a rustling sound followed by a thud in his garden. When he investigated, he found a white hockey ball resting among dry leaves.

short_answer.question: Why did the children burst into laughter instead of being sad about losing the ball?
short_answer.answer: The children found the unexpected and funny way the ball landed in a passing scooter's basket hilarious, celebrating the surprising moment together.

long_answer.question: Narrate the event that led to the hockey ball disappearing with the scooter, and highlight the spirit of friendship among the children.
long_answer.answer: While playing an energetic game of hockey, Jay tightened his grip and hit the ball with great force. The ball soared past the playground gate and landed right in the basket of a scooter driving past. The scooterist was completely unaware and kept riding away. When the children ran to the gate, both the scooter and the ball were gone. Instead of blaming Jay or getting upset, the children shared a cheerful look and burst into collective laughter, demonstrating true sportsmanship and joyous friendship.
rubric: 2 Marks: Clear sequence of events leading to the ball landing in the basket
2 Marks: Description of children's reaction and friendship spirit
